expectations.evidence: KPIs are mostly conventional click/conversion and delivery metrics: "Cost per petition signature / MEP contact generated (primary metric)" and "Video completion rate (YouTube, target >50%)" — both depend on exactly the click/last-touch reads that are weak for DOOH, creator, native and awareness video. Two items gesture beyond that: "Media mentions / share of voice vs. fishing-industry lobby messaging" (an off-platform proxy) and "Post-vote: correlate campaign-heavy constituencies against how their MEPs voted."
